column1: New Zealand’s National Party spokesman on education, Dr Lockwood Smith, recently visited the US and Britain.
column2: 新西兰国家党教育发言人洛克伍德·史密斯博士最近访问了美国和英国。

column1: Here he reports on the findings of his trip and what they could mean for New Zealand’s education policy
column2: 他在文章中报道了这次旅行的发现，以及这些发现可能对新西兰的教育政策产生的影响。

column1: ‘Education to Be More’ was published last August.
column2: 《教育应更进一步》一书于去年八月出版。

column1: It was the report of the New Zealand Government’s Early Childhood Care and Education Working Group.
column2: 这是新西兰政府儿童保育与教育工作组的报告。

column1: The report argued for enhanced equity of access and better funding for childcare and early childhood education institutions.
column2: 报告主张，让人们有更公平的机会获得托育与幼儿教育服务，并为提供这些服务的机构改善经费保障。
column5: equity of access|n. 获得服务机会的公平性
column8: early childhood education|n. 幼儿教育

column1: Unquestionably, that’s a real need; but since parents don’t normally send children to pre-schools until the age of three, are we missing out on the most important years of all?
column2: 毫无疑问，这确实是一个必要的需求；不过，由于父母通常会在孩子三岁之前不送他们去幼儿园，那么我们是不是错过了所有重要阶段中的最关键时期呢？

column1: A 13-year study of early childhood development at Harvard University has shown that, by the age of three, most children have the potential to understand about 1000 words – most of the language they will use in ordinary conversation for the rest of their lives.
column2: 哈佛大学一项历时13年的幼儿发展研究表明，到三岁时，大多数儿童就有能力理解约1000个词，这些词占他们此后一生在日常交谈中所用词汇的大部分。
column4: early childhood development|n. 幼儿发展
column5: by the age of three|到三岁时
column9: for the rest of their lives|在此后的一生中

column1: Furthermore, research has shown that while every child is born with a natural curiosity, it can be suppressed dramatically during the second and third years of life.
column2: 此外，研究表明，虽然每个孩子天生都具备好奇心，但在生命的第二年和第三年阶段，这种好奇心可能会被严重抑制。

column1: Researchers claim that the human personality is formed during the first two years of life, and during the first three years children learn the basic skills they will use in all their later learning both at home and at school.
column2: 研究人员认为，人的个性在出生后的头两年形成。在头三年里，儿童会学到一些基本技能，此后无论在家还是在学校，学习时都会用到这些技能。
column6: during the first two years|在头两年里
column10: both at home and at school|无论在家还是在学校

column1: Once over the age of three, children continue to expand on existing knowledge of the world.
column2: 三岁以后，孩子们在已有认识的基础上，继续加深对世界的了解。
column3: over the age of three|超过三岁
column5: expand on|在原有基础上拓展

column1: It is generally acknowledged that young people from poorer socio-economic backgrounds tend to do less well in our education system.
column2: 普遍认为，来自社会经济状况较差的年轻人在教育系统中的表现较差。

column1: That’s observed not just in New Zealand, but also in Australia, Britain and America.
column2: 这种现象不仅在新西兰，也在澳大利亚、英国和美国被观察到。

column1: In an attempt to overcome that educational under-achievement, a nationwide programme called ‘Headstart’ was launched in the United States in 1965.
column2: 为了克服教育上的不足，美国在1965年启动了一项名为‘Headstart’的全国性计划。

column1: A lot of money was poured into it.
column2: 大量的资金被投入到了这个项目上。

column1: It took children into pre-school institutions at the age of three and was supposed to help the children of poorer families succeed in school.
column2: 这项计划要求儿童在三岁岁时进入学前教育机构，其目的是帮助那些来自贫困家庭的儿童在学业上取得更好的成绩。

column1: Despite substantial funding, results have been disappointing.
column2: 尽管投入了大量资金，成果却令人失望。

column1: It is thought that there are two explanations for this.
column2: 人们认为，这种现象有两种可能的解释。

column1: First, the programme began too late.
column2: 首先，项目开始的时间太晚。

column1: Many children who entered it at the age of three were already behind their peers in language and measurable intelligence.
column2: 许多在三岁时进入早期教育的孩子，在语言和可测量的智力方面已经落后于同龄人。

column1: Second, the parents were not involved.
column2: 其次，家长没有参与。

column1: At the end of each day, ‘Headstart’ children returned to the same disadvantaged home environment.
column2: 每天结束时，参加‘Headstart’项目的孩子们仍然会回到那些处于不利环境的家庭环境中。

column1: As a result of the growing research evidence of the importance of the first three years of a child’s life and the disappointing results from ‘Headstart’, a pilot programme was launched in Missouri in the US that focused on parents as the child’s first teachers.
column2: 由于越来越多的研究表明儿童前三年的生命至关重要，而‘Headstart’项目的成果却令人失望，美国密苏里州启动了一项试点项目，将父母视为儿童的首位教师。

column1: The ‘Missouri’ programme was predicated on research showing that working with the family, rather than bypassing the parents, is the most effective way of helping children get off to the best possible start in life.
column2: “密苏里”项目所依据的研究表明，与家庭合作、让父母参与，是帮助孩子获得最佳人生起点的最有效方法。
column5: working with the family|与家庭合作
column8: most effective way|n. 最有效的方法

column1: The four-year pilot study included 380 families who were about to have their first child and who represented a cross-section of socio-economic status, age and family configurations.
column2: 这项为期四年的试点研究纳入了380个即将迎来第一个孩子的家庭，涵盖不同的社会经济状况、父母年龄和家庭结构。
column3: four-year pilot study|n. 为期四年的试点研究
column8: socio-economic status|n. 社会经济状况

column1: They included single-parent and two-parent families, families in which both parents worked, and families with either the mother or father at home.
column2: 这些家庭包括单亲家庭和双亲家庭、父母双方都工作的家庭，以及母亲或父亲在家照顾孩子的家庭。

column1: The programme involved trained parent-educators visiting the parents’ home and working with the parent, or parents, and the child.
column2: 该计划包括由经过培训的家庭指导员前往家长家中，与家长或父母以及孩子一起工作的内容。

column1: Information on child development, and guidance on things to look for and expect as the child grows were provided, plus guidance in fostering the child’s intellectual, language, social and motor-skill development.
column2: 项目向家长介绍儿童发展知识，指导他们在孩子成长过程中留意哪些迹象、可以预期哪些变化，还指导他们培养孩子的智力、语言能力、社交能力和运动技能。
column11: motor-skill development|n. 运动技能发展

column1: Periodic check-ups of the child’s educational and sensory development (hearing and vision) were made to detect possible handicaps that interfere with growth and development.
column2: 会定期对儿童的教育能力和感官发育情况进行检查（包括听力与视力方面），以发现可能妨碍其成长和发展的障碍。

column1: Medical problems were referred to professionals.
column2: 那些医疗问题被移交给了专业人士来处理。

column1: Parent-educators made personal visits to homes and monthly group meetings were held with other new parents to share experience and discuss topics of interest.
column2: 家长教育辅导员会亲自上门家访，此外还每月组织新手父母聚会，让他们交流经验，讨论感兴趣的话题。
column4: personal visits|n. 亲自上门拜访
column9: topics of interest|n. 感兴趣的话题

column1: Parent resource centres, located in school buildings, offered learning materials for families and facilitators for child care.
column2: 设在校舍里的家长资源中心为家庭提供学习资料，还安排人员协助照看儿童。
column3: Parent resource centres|n. 家长资源中心

column1: At the age of three, the children who had been involved in the “Missouri” programme were evaluated alongside a cross-section of children selected from the same range of socio-economic backgrounds and family situations, and also a random sample of children that age.
column2: 参加“密苏里”项目的儿童在三岁时接受了评估。与他们一同接受评估的，一组是从相同范围的社会经济背景和家庭状况中选出的代表性儿童，另一组则是随机抽取的同龄儿童。
column8: socio-economic backgrounds|n. 社会经济背景

column1: The results were phenomenal.
column2: 结果非常出色。

column1: By the age of three, the children in the programme were significantly more advanced in language development than their peers, had made greater strides in problem solving and other intellectual skills, and were further along in social development.
column2: 到三岁时，参加项目的儿童在语言发展上已明显领先于同龄人，在解决问题和其他智力技能上也取得了更大进步，社交能力的发展同样更为超前。
column3: By the age of three|到三岁时
column8: made greater strides|取得更大进步
column12: social development|n. 社交能力的发展

column1: In fact, the average child on the programme was performing at the level of the top 15 to 20 per cent of their peers in such things as auditory comprehension, verbal ability and language ability.
column2: 事实上，参与该项目的儿童在听觉理解、言语能力和语言能力方面，发展水平达到了同龄人中前15%到20%的水平。

column1: Most important of all, the traditional measures of ‘risk’, such as parents’ age and education, or whether they were a single parent, bore little or no relationship to the measures of achievement and language development.
column2: 最重要的是，传统的‘风险’指标，如父母的年龄和受教育程度，或是否为单亲家庭，与孩子的学业成就和语言发展之间几乎没有任何关联。

column1: Children in the programme performed equally well regardless of socio-economic disadvantages.
column2: 该项目中的孩子无论社会经济状况如何，表现都同样出色。

column1: Child abuse was virtually eliminated.
column2: 儿童虐待几乎被消除。

column1: The one factor that was found to affect the child’s development was family stress leading to a poor quality of parent-child interaction.
column2: 研究发现，影响儿童发展的唯一因素是家庭压力，这种压力会导致父母与子女之间互动质量下降。

column1: That interaction was not necessarily bad in poorer families.
column2: 在贫困家庭中，这种互动未必是坏事。

column1: These research findings are exciting.
column2: 这些研究发现令人兴奋。

column1: There is growing evidence in New Zealand that children from poorer socio-economic backgrounds are arriving at school less well developed and that our school system tends to perpetuate that disadvantage.
column2: 在新西兰，有越来越多的证据表明，来自经济条件较差家庭的儿童在入学时各方面的发展较为滞后，而我们的教育体系似乎助长了这种不平等现象。

column1: The initiative outlined above could break that cycle of disadvantage.
column2: 上述举措可能打破这种不利循环。

column1: The concept of working with parents in their homes, or at their place of work, contrasts quite markedly with the report of the Early Childhood Care and Education Working Group.
column2: 与幼儿保育与教育工作组的报告相比，让家长在家中或工作场所参与教育活动的理念有着明显的不同。

column1: Their focus is on getting children and mothers access to childcare and institutionalised early childhood education.
column2: 他们关注的是如何让儿童和母亲获得托育服务，以及由专门机构提供的幼儿教育。
column6: institutionalised|adj. 由专门机构提供的
column7: early childhood education|n. 幼儿教育

column1: Education from the age of three to five is undoubtedly vital, but without a similar focus on parent education and on the vital importance of the first three years, some evidence indicates that it will not be enough to overcome educational inequity.
column2: 从三岁到五岁的教育无疑至关重要，但如果不同时重视家长教育以及前三年的极端重要性，一些证据表明，仅靠这一阶段的教育是不足以克服教育不公平的。
